newsitem.title: UK: Meyer says trading remains in line.
newsitem.headline: Meyer says trading remains in line.

text.p: British building materials and timber group Meyer International Plc said on Monday business remained in line with November's announcement of its half-year results.

"The roll-out of Jewson's investment and relaunch programme is substantially complete and the branch network has recently been expanded...The group's trading continues in line with the announcement of our half-year results in November," Meyer said.
Meyer said gearing was low and its balance sheet "healthy".

In November, Meyer said there were improvements in its key markets but that these were unlikely to make an impact on results until 1997. Forest products business improved and Meyer predicted increased demand for timber and building materials on the back of an improvement in housing starts and transactions.
